defects_resolved.root_cause: Control plane facade assigned all obligations to first changed file
defects_resolved.remediation: Added source_paths and primary_source_path to Change class; mapped obligations to source files via capability_resolution.classified_changes
defects_resolved.verification: Multi-file changes preserve individual provenance; reordering doesn't affect provenance

defects_resolved.root_cause: Frontend app/components/hooks paths not in SOURCE_CHANGE classification
defects_resolved.remediation: Added frontend/app/, frontend/components/, frontend/hooks/ to classification; integrated cross-layer graph for frontend→backend mapping
defects_resolved.verification: All frontend paths produce obligations with correct backend capability attribution

defects_resolved.root_cause: Router files not mapped to engine capabilities
defects_resolved.remediation: Built router-to-capability mapping from cross-layer graph; added _get_router_capabilities() method
defects_resolved.verification: Router changes now produce obligations for their owning engine

defects_resolved.root_cause: O(n²) AST walk in symbol_resolver.py caused timeouts on large files
defects_resolved.remediation: Replaced nested ast.walk() with single-pass O(n) traversal using class stack tracking
defects_resolved.verification: 15k-line files process in ~1s instead of timing out (>120s)

defects_resolved.root_cause: Framework accepted arbitrary threshold values without validation
defects_resolved.verification: Out-of-range and inverted thresholds detected correctly

data_gaps_addressed.description: platform console routes lack backend capability mapping
data_gaps_addressed.resolution: Documented as known gap; platform hooks exist but have no backend dependencies in cross-layer graph
